subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie@acme-infra.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up

Hi Alicia / Raj — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking through Acme's integration goals. Per our call, attached is a draft MAP focused on the integration build plan milestone. Key items called out: SDK integration, low-latency streaming, tool-calling (calendar/DB lookups), and structured outputs for downstream processing.

Please review the milestone owners and dependencies below and tell me if anything needs to change. I want to lock owners and target dates so our engineering teams can capacity plan.

Draft milestones (high level):
- Milestone 1: SDK integration (public SDK + auth flows) — owner: Mateo Alvarez (Redwood) — target: 2026-04-15
  - Dependencies: API key provisioning, test tenant from Acme
- Milestone 2: Streaming & low-latency (client stream + chunked responses) — owner: Dylan Brooks (Redwood SE) — target: 2026-04-22
  - Dependencies: agreement on max token/latency SLOs, network egress testing
- Milestone 3: Tool calling & connectors (Calendar, Internal DB) — owner: Alicia/Acme (customer owner), Redwood support: Marissa — target: 2026-05-01
  - Dependencies: connector credentials, schema for calls
- Milestone 4: Structured outputs & schema validation (JSON schema + post-processing) — owner: Acme data team / Redwood (integration support) — target: 2026-05-08
- Milestone 5: End-to-end tests & canary rollout — owner: Evelyn Hart (Redwood CS) — target: 2026-05-15

Attachments: ACME-Redwood-MAP-draft-v2.docx (MAP with milestones + responsibilities), integration_schema.png (high-level data flow).

Next steps requested:
1) Confirm internal owners on your side for Milestones 3 & 4 (tool calling & structured outputs).
2) Share a test tenant or API sandbox creds by next Wednesday (2026-03-04) if possible.
3) Mateo/Dylan: can you flag any technical blockers or extra capacity needed?

Thanks — I'll update the MAP doc after I hear back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie@acme-infra.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T12:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and thorough. Quick notes from our side after the call:
- We can own the calendar DB connector (Milestone 3) — I'll put Raj as the primary owner and loop our infra lead (Sophie) for credentials.
- For structured outputs (Milestone 4) our data team needs the JSON schema by 2026-03-10 to validate ingest. Can Redwood provide an initial schema draft this week?
- Target close looks achievable given the timelines, but we may need a 1-week buffer on Milestone 2 depending on network testing results.

Action items for Acme:
- Assign Raj Patel as Milestone 3 owner — will confirm by end of day 2026-03-02.
- Sophie will provision a test tenant / sandbox creds by 2026-03-04 (tentative).

A few questions for Redwood team:
- Do you have a recommended streaming client for our web app (React) or do you prefer we use the SDK?
- For tool calling auth, what's the recommended pattern for short-lived tokens vs service accounts?

We'll review the attached MAP and comment inline on the doc.

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Director of Product Integrations, Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up

Thanks Alicia — great, helpful notes. Answers inline:
- Streaming client: we recommend using the Redwood JS SDK for web (React) which wraps the streaming socket and reconnection logic. SDK will be in the Milestone 1 deliverable but we can provide a reference React sample that uses the streaming endpoint. Dylan, can you add a quick sample to the repo and link it to the MAP?
- Tool calling auth: recommended pattern is short-lived OAuth tokens for user-scoped actions (calendar) and a Redwood-managed service account for server-to-server DB lookups. We'll document both patterns in the integration guide (Milestone 1/3).

I updated the MAP doc in Drive with a first-pass JSON schema for structured outputs (see link). I'll share the schema file as ACME-structured-output-schema.json inside the Drive folder.

Dylan / Mateo: please confirm blockers or estimation for the SDK + streaming work by EOD tomorrow (2026-02-28).

Marissa
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-28T14:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up

On Fri, Feb 27, 2026 at 08:45 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Dylan / Mateo: please confirm blockers or estimation for the SDK + streaming work by EOD tomorrow (2026-02-28).

Thanks Marissa — quick update from engineering side:
- SDK integration: estimate ~2 dev-weeks to add Acme-specific auth flows and publish a 0.1.0 package for them to try. Can start on 2026-03-08 once we have sandbox creds. Owner: Mateo (will coordinate with Acme infra).
- Streaming: low-latency streaming support is already in our runtime; Dylan will add a React example and a small helper in the SDK. Estimate: 3-4 engineering days for the example + docs. Owner: Dylan.
- Blockers: need the sandbox creds and a list of SLO targets (p50/p95 latency). Also need clarity on whether Acme will use server-side aggregation for tokens or client-side streaming for partial renders.

I'll add these estimates to the MAP doc and flag the dependencies.

- Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling) - draft follow-up

Quick confirmation from my side:
- I'll add the React streaming example and a short note on chunking semantics to the Drive folder by 2026-03-03.
- I'll also include a small checklist for network egress testing (ports, TLS versions, bandwidth assumptions).
- No major infra blockers on our side; once sandbox creds are live we can run a quick smoke test.

Evelyn, I'll coordinate the canary rollout plan with you once we get to Milestone 5 (tentative 2026-05-15).

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
